Analytical Validation Report: Germline SNV/Indel Panel

GermlineQC v1.0.0 · GIAB HG001 / HG002 · chr20 panel (JAG1, GNAS loci)

1. Summary

The pipeline meets 6 of 7 pre-defined acceptance criteria. Not met: Repeatability (min pairwise concordance). See section 6 for the investigation and corrective action. All samples are reference material from the Genome in a Bottle consortium, sequenced on Illumina HiSeq 2500 (2 x 148 bp) and benchmarked against the GIAB v4.2.1 truth sets inside GIAB high-confidence regions that overlap the panel.

Specificity

Specificity is reported per base: every high-confidence reference position that is not a truth variant counts as a negative, and any PASS call there is a false positive. Because nearly all positions are reference, this figure is always very close to 100%. PPV is the more informative measure of false-positive burden, so both are reported.

6. Findings and corrective action

Finding 1: repeatability below target. The lowest pairwise concordance between same-batch replicates was 97.92% against a target of 99%. Discordant calls are enriched for low read depth: 22% of discordant calls have fewer than 15 reads, compared with 3% of concordant calls. This points to random sampling of reads at ~30x rather than a systematic pipeline fault (the same replicates reach 99.00% or better SNV sensitivity).

Finding 2: the 30x replicates do not meet the per-sample coverage gate. Only 89.9% to 91.2% of target bases reach 20x, below the 95% requirement. In the titration series the gate is first met at 49.9x nominal depth (47.1x observed). SNV sensitivity reaches 99% from 30x.

Corrective action. The acceptance criteria are not changed after the fact. Instead:

  1. Minimum sequencing depth for the assay is set to 49.9x mean target depth, the lowest level at which both the coverage gate and the sensitivity target are met.
  2. Repeatability and reproducibility must be repeated with replicates at that depth before the assay is released. The GIAB data used here supports at most ~34x per same-batch replicate on this panel, so this needs new sequencing of the reference material.
  3. Until then, calls with depth < 15 or GQ < 20 are flagged for manual review (query 6 in sql/queries.sql).

7. Limitations

  • The panel covers 1.5 Mb of chr20, so indel counts are small and their confidence intervals are wide. A clinical validation would add more loci and more reference samples (for example HG003 to HG007) to reach the sample sizes in the validation plan.
  • Repeatability and reproducibility replicates are read subsets from GIAB sequencing runs rather than separate library preparations, so they capture sequencing and analysis variation but not wet-lab variation.
  • Only regions that GIAB marks as high-confidence are scored. Difficult regions (segmental duplications, long homopolymers) are outside the benchmark and need separate handling, for example with orthogonal confirmation.
  • Copy-number variants, structural variants and mosaic variants are out of scope.
